description: The autonomy.vocabulary happy path (S56 T6): the closed descriptor set a form reads and never re-types (AL15). Subjects come from the action registry through its exported accessors (local actions excluded — a grant on one is refused); the one class shorthand covers the current outward names; conditions carry their plain-English help and where they are evaluated (pin or action); limits are the closed bounds the validator enforces. The result is the view at top level — no wrapper.

conditions.name: requireGates
conditions.description: the merge rule (S57) must pass at the moment of the merge; the only condition a merge grant may carry, and it is forced on

conditions.name: requireBudget
conditions.description: the loop's governing budgets are not exhausted; on by default on every allow

conditions.name: labels
conditions.description: the start's label set must intersect this list; empty means any

conditions.name: maxPerDay
conditions.description: no more than this many begun uses in the last 24 hours
